person.name: V. Srinivasa Rangan
person.profile: Re-appointed for one year from 23 Nov 2026 after RBI approval; heads HR, Corporate Legal, Secretarial, Investment Banking, Information Security and Fraud & Vigilance. Former Executive Director & CFO of HDFC Ltd before its July 2023 merger with the Bank. B.Com (University of Delhi) and Chartered Accountant (ICAI); named ICAI's Best CFO in the Financial Sector, 2010.

https://www.bseindia.com/stockinfo/AnnPd.summary: Board re-appointed ED V. Srinivasa Rangan for 1 year from 23 Nov 2026 at existing pay, subject to shareholder approval.
RBI approved re-appointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as Executive Director for 1 year from 23 Nov 2026.

person.name: Sanjay D'Souza
person.role: Group Head – Business Banking, Emerging & Micro Enterprises Group (Senior Management), HDFC Bank
person.profile: Superannuated on 31 Oct 2026 after nearly 27 years with the Bank. The Bank describes him as one of the key architects of its SME business across credit and business roles. No successor named in the filing.

person.name: Leo Puri
person.profile: Shareholders approved (postal ballot, 6 Nov 2026) his appointment as Independent Director for 7 Sep 2026 – 6 Sep 2031. He becomes Chairman on 23 Jan 2027, when R. Seshasayee's term ends. The filing refers to the 7 Sep 2026 disclosure for his detailed profile.

person.name: Sanjeev Shankaran
person.role: Vice President – General Merchandising (Senior Management), Avenue Supermarts
person.profile: Commerce graduate with a part-time PGDM from AIMA Delhi (2005). Joined DMart in Sep 2021 (VP – Operations) after 20+ years at FMCG companies including Dabur and Kellogg's; last role at Dabur was National Key Account Manager, MT & Ecom Head.

https://www.bseindia.com/stockinfo/AnnPd.summary: Senior management reshuffle from 16 Nov 2026: Shankaran to VP General Merchandising; Dastgir Shaikh moves to VP FMCG; Sachin Jaolekar moves to Avenue E-Commerce and exits SMP.

person.name: Shrirang Anilrao Kothe
person.profile: Appointed CEO of HAL's Helicopter Complex on 13 Nov 2026, succeeding P B Rangarao, who moved up as Director (Operations). The filing gives no further profile.

person.name: P B Rangarao
person.profile: Appointed by MoD as Additional Director – Director (Operations) for five years from 28 Oct 2026, taking over the additional charge held by CMD Kota Ravi. A 31-year HAL veteran (joined 1995 as a design trainee) who rose through helicopter manufacturing to GM and ED of the Helicopter Division, then CEO (Helicopter Complex). B.E. Mechanical (REC Warangal), PGDBM (XIME Bengaluru), IIM Ahmedabad leadership programme.
